verdict.rationale: USPTO does run its own API surface. Patent Center refers to users making direct API calls to Workbench/view applications. A live api.uspto.gov endpoint answers keyless requests with a structured 'Missing Authentication Token' challenge, which implies an API-key model. A developer portal exists at developer.uspto.gov, but its docs render only via JavaScript and could not be read, and the standard OpenAPI paths all return 404. Missing for 10: readable published endpoint documentation, a documented key-issuance path, stated rate limits on USPTO's own pages, and a machine-readable spec.
